case_name: Poorveeben Vinaybhai Trivedi vs Vinaybhai Rajeshbhai Trivedi on 5 December, 2023
acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: The parties are married under the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. The respondent-husband has been physically and mentally torturing the petitioner-wife. She seeks divorce on grounds of cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: A petition for divorce under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is maintainable only if there has been a breakdown in the marriage.
legal_principles.held: It is held that a petition for divorce under Section 13 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 is maintainable only if there has been a breakdown in the marriage. The burden lies on the petitioner to prove that the marriage has broken down irretrievably.

legal_principles.principle: The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 is a beneficial legislation aimed at providing relief to women who are victims of domestic violence.
legal_principles.held: It is settled law that the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 is a beneficial legislation aimed at providing relief to women who are victims of domestic violence. The Act is designed to provide protection and relief to women who are subjected to domestic violence.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005

outcome.final_order: The final court order allows the petition for divorce.
